items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Oh well, Johnny Hill played trumpet, I played trumpet, Esau Lewis played trumpet, and what are those four trumpets? Johnny, myself, Esau Lewis, and Holly Taylor.

ctx.x: We might as well get those names and instruments together in Raceland. Who played which instrument?
Oh well, Johnny Hill played trumpet, I played trumpet, Esau Lewis played trumpet, and what are those four trumpets? Johnny, myself, Esau Lewis, and Holly Taylor.
Why don't you put them down? That's right there. Oh that's right.
